slides.title: Messages in packets
slides.text: Every message on the internet is cut into numbered packets. They travel through routers and are rebuilt at the other end.
slides.alt: Five packets, two lost on the way: packet 1 sits in its mail slot, and packets 2 and 4 wait in the inbox.

focus.cue: Five numbered packets, two lost on the way
Arrived packets go in their numbered slots

slides.title: Rules everyone follows
slides.text: A protocol is a set of rules every computer on the network agrees on. Without the same rules everywhere, a packet could not be passed on or rebuilt.
slides.alt: What goes wrong on this road: packet 3 never arrives, packet 2 arrives twice, they arrive mixed up. Below, the first four rule cards to pick from.

focus.cue: Three things go wrong on this road
A rule set every computer follows catches them

slides.title: Say got it
slides.text: The receiver says got it for each packet and asks again for a missing one. Extra copies are thrown away.
slides.alt: Got 1, 2, 3 and 4: four mail slots are ticked, and packet 5, asked for again, is in the inbox.

focus.cue: Got it: each arrived packet is ticked
A missing packet, asked for again, arrives

slides.title: Damaged on the way?
slides.text: A checksum is a count sent along with a packet. If the count does not match when it arrives, the packet was damaged, so it is sent again.
slides.alt: Every packet carries a dot count. Count the dots: a packet whose dots do not match what it says was damaged.

focus.cue: Each packet says how many dots it carries
Count them: a mismatch means damage

slides.title: Hops
slides.text: Each jump from one router to the next is a hop. If a router is busy, pick another path that still fits the hop budget.
slides.alt: Hop budget: thirteen hops for four packets. Packet 2 of 4 is on the road, and the counter reads Hops: 3 of 13.

focus.cue: The hop budget: 13 hops for 4 packets

words.means: shared rules computers follow to talk
say got it when a packet arrives
send a missing or damaged packet again
a count that shows if a packet was damaged

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Rules of the Road and finish all 6 levels, then two Many Roads levels with a hop budget.
